Nina (Growth): Quick plan: short launch + tiny credit drip for webinar regs. Test two post-reg flows and three prompt-template bundles. KPI: +20% reg->first_api_call within 7 days.

Owen (Content): Nice. What are the flows?

Nina (Growth): Flow A = immediate redeem link + short email; Flow B = staggered drip (day 1 email, day 3 nudge). Templates: Starter, Vertical, Playbook. Randomize at RSVP complete.

Marta (Analytics): Tracking window = 7d. Events: `webinar_rsvp`,`email_sent_variant`,`template_assigned`,`credit_redeemed`,`first_api_call`,`nudge_clicked`. I will build a funnel tile.

Jules (Ops): Routing question: do we ping SDRs on any credit redemption or only demo clicks?

Nina (Growth): For this test, SDR ping only if `demo_clicked` OR high credit tier redeemed. Otherwise keep nurture. Add HubSpot prop `mkt_arm`.

Owen (Content): Copy drafts (ultra short):
- Starter: "Thanks — try these quick prompts + credits inside."
- Vertical: "Your <vertical> templates + credits are ready."
- Playbook: "Step-by-step playbook + credits — build in 30m."

Marta (Analytics): Can we also tag UTMs `utm_experiment=spark_activation` and pass `exp_arm` in event payloads? I'll need that for the dashboard.

Jules (Ops): will add `exp_arm` and `credit_tier` to HubSpot mapping. notify-bot: queued mapping update.

notify-bot: experiment created: `exp_2112223333_spark_activation_drip` — arms: FlowA/FlowB x Starter/Vertical/Playbook. Dry-run Mon 09:00 PT.

amp-bot: Amplitude schema updated: added events [`template_assigned`,`credit_redeemed`,`nudge_clicked`]. Schema link: https://amplitude.company/schemas/exp_2112223333

Marta (Analytics): Timeline: tracking signoff Fri, creative by Fri EOD, dashboard by Wed, dry-run Mon, full launch Thu. I'll also add a baseline comparison to last webinar.

Nina (Growth): Owners: Owen = copy & template content, Marta = tracking + dashboard, Jules = HubSpot mapping & routing. Quick sync Fri 11am to confirm.

Owen (Content): I'll post email HTML + 3 template packs to #marketing-assets by Thu.

Jules (Ops): noted. Also adding dedupe rule: if duplicate RSVPs, keep highest credit tier and set `dedupe=true`.

Nina (Growth): thanks — want the RSVP -> redeem flow minimal friction. Flag any edge-case routing here. :sparkles:
